metadata.coverage: Existing official2022 EauRouge/Raidillon/Kemmel footprints plus real2023GT3Cup runoff, red-yellow local curbs, Armco, covered impact protection and selected fences around major corners.
metadata.method: Real2023onboard track-relative reconstruction, cross-checked against official2022 works/colours and dated2023aerial in2024publication.
metadata.horizontalGeometry: Existing15footprints retained; new canonical interval endpoints approximately45-50m uncertain, widths/offsets/vegetation bands visually estimated. Not a survey.
metadata.verticalGeometry: New scenery foundations sampled from the actual displayed terrain. Original road/terrain heights and official2026 elevation profile unchanged; no new DEM or mountain survey.
metadata.dateLimitation: 2023preseason video follows2022safety works but precedes2024resurfacing/2025localrepairs. Aerial filename20230707 is distinct from its2024article. No2026completecondition guarantee.
metadata.omitted: Unseen sponsor advertising/overhead PORSCHE bridge, unverified barrier cores and unobserved exact landscaping are omitted.
limitations: Real2023DirkSchoutenPorsche992GT3Cuppreseason lap, not an F1lap or2026survey. No unrelated F1sponsors are imported.
Canonical7004m and originalGPstraight origin are retained; per-vehicle/sharedracingline distances differ. GP and downhill Endurance pit complexes remain separate.
Official2022 black/yellow/red Raidillon and Chicane runoff is painted asphalt, not gravel. Covered red-yellow impact protection is a different vertical object.
Near asphalt and farther loose aggregate are separate at Pouhon and Blanchimont; no blanket gravel inference from pale paint or a spectator map.

Existing15observedfootprints/3woodlandregions remain; original153treeXY/heights/radii retained, roots grounded. Four additional photo/video-backed woodland envelopes have estimated individual tree positions, size and growthform; no species/survey claim.
Background illustrative tree target is reduced400to200 while adding observed woodland envelopes, keeping estimated scenery separate from original source observations.

Original two pitwalls and all39pitfeatures/focus remain unchanged and are excluded from new duplicate barrier traces. Existing pitbuilding ground-height mismatch is a recorded baseline, not a new surveyed facility model.
OriginalDEM/official2026profileanchors/roadgeometry/vehiclephysics/timing unchanged; ground materials paint existing terrain planes, without floating new sheets.

sources.sourceType: first-person actual driver onboard, not a videogame or official F1 broadcast
sources.visualReview: All three contact sheets directly inspected; exact segment/side proposals are handled by the separate frame mapping audit
observations: Red/yellow kerbs and protection colours, green painted margins, gravel beyond some corner exit kerbs, asphalt escape paths, metal Armco and catch fences are visible
The video postdates2022 reconstruction but predates June2024 resurfacing and July2025 local repairs
limits: Upload date is not an exact capture date
Perspective video does not survey runoff polygons, wall heights or underlying protection material
No2025/2026 sponsor layout is inferred from this2023test-day video
sources.rights: Original video/photographs/PDF inspected locally only; not distributed as textures or meshes.

sources.access: Official PDF full text read via web; direct download403, no bypass
observations: Gravel brought closer to T1 exit, gravel behind narrowed T7 exit kerb and near T9 exit
Additional gravel listed at T10–11, T12–13, T14–15, T17 and T18
T2–4 runoff enlarged by up to25m with barrier/fence realignment; new barriers/debris fences at T5–6 andT17
V2 also records removal of three T6 runoff speed bumps and the temporary T9 kerb
limits: Corner list does not supply each trap boundary or side
Do not reinstate earlier temporaryT9kerb using the superseded first notes
Gravel changes do not mean all asphalt runoff was removed

sources.title: The Spa-Francorchamps track is decked out in new colours
observations: Operator identifies yellow/red track kerbs and black/yellow/red painted runoff at EauRouge/Raidillon and Chicane exit
Image shows continuous tri-colour paved apron left of the climb, paved apron at right of the crest, green paved areas and separate right grass/service road
Red/yellow stacked tyres are visible along the left outer barrier in this2022image
limits: Photograph publication date is2022-08-24; exact capture date not stated
Do not classify bright runoff paint as gravel or grass
Tyre construction visible in this photo does not prove every colour-covered barrier is made of tyres

observations: 3.5km track plus over600m pitlane resurfacing: T17→T2, T4→T8 and T14→T15
Article also states1km debris fencing, emergency accesses and SpeakerCorner drainage/grooving/newkerb work
limits: Postdates supplied2023video
Resurfacing is not evidence to turn existing gravel traps into asphalt
Fencing total does not establish exact localsegments or postspacing

sources.publisher: Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps; file credits Simon Schmitt / Globalview
sources.captureDateHint: Filename explicitly says7-juillet-2023; separate from articledate
observations: Large portion of the circuit shows mixed forest, grass, tan aggregate traps, asphalt escape routes and green painted runoff
Useful independent context for LesCombes/Bruxelles/Pouhon/Fagnes/Stavelot/Blanchimont, beyond the old Raidillon-only source
limits: Oblique image is not a georeferenced orthophoto or material survey
No photogrammetric transform or exact trap polygon is claimed in this research
Do not label image as post-June2024resurfacing

sources.visualReview: Single PDF page rendered to operator-map-2024-p1.png and directly inspected
observations: Names and corner order, grandstands, public paths/accesses and pit complex locations
limits: Legend is visitor/event infrastructure, not a georeferenced runoff material boundary survey
Brown bronze spectator zones must not be read as gravel traps; green parking/access areas are not grass classification

sources.access: Official PDF full text read via web; direct download403, no bypass
